messages:
maria (Sec Eng): idp-bot just alerted on a cluster of session revokes for ~40 accounts in last 10m, with distinct source IPs and two concurrent regions. Possible impossible-travel pattern. details: https://idp.internal/alerts/1839991110 :eyes:

idp-bot: ALERT: Suspicious session activity detected. event_count=42 impacted_accounts=37 regions=us-east-1,eu-west-1 reason="session_revoke_threshold"

samir (IAM): I'm seeing a spike in failed MFA pushes too, looks like push-fatigue attempts. Correlating with session revokes now.

jason (SRE): Any common apps? Service accounts? Could be scripted token refresh abuse.

maria (Sec Eng): Most affected are human users across product and platform - not service accounts. Need containment: force logout for impacted users + temporary block new SSO sessions from suspect IP ranges.

ellie (Product Sec): Notified product leads, adding to incident channel.

ops-oncall: I'll run a quick session dump and IP block. Command:
```
# list sessions where revoked=true and timestamp>now-15m
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.internal/api/sessions?revoked=true&since=15m" | jq .
```

samir (IAM): I can revoke refresh tokens org-wide for the impacted cohort and rotate client secrets for implicated apps. Recommend we also force password reset for any legacy SSO fallback accounts.

maria (Sec Eng): Do that. Also enable high-fidelity logging for KMS calls and key access for 24h in case of lateral movement.

jason (SRE): For mitigation, I'm pushing a firewall rule to block 185.62.37.0/24 and 45.77.12.0/24 for SSO endpoints. Will also enable rate-limit on auth POSTs.

idp-bot: ACTIONS: MFA challenges flagged + session revokes applied. tracker=#INC-2026-1839

ellie (Product Sec): What's our comms plan? Should we notify affected users or wait until containment done?

maria (Sec Eng): Notify via redirect landing page and email with steps to reauthenticate; mark as security update. Avoid saying 'breach' until we confirm.

samir (IAM): Postmortem tasks: audit log extract, list of compromised IPs, rotate KMS keys if we find evidence of key access. I'll take KMS logs.

jason (SRE): I'm seeing a spike in token-exchange API 429s, likely automated retry loops hitting rate-limits. Suggest temporary stricter quotas for anonymous clients.

maria (Sec Eng): Good. After containment, we need follow-ups: 1) update RBAC rules to reduce token scope 2) add an eval that simulates push-fatigue to detect future attempts 3) update runbooks.

ellie (Product Sec): I'll coordinate comms and postmortem timeline.

ops-oncall: Blocking rules applied and session revokes executed. Will follow up with session counts in 10m.

maria (Sec Eng): Thanks. Keep thread updated. Adding incident review to calendar for tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

jason (SRE): 10-4. saving outputs to /var/log/sec/1839991110-sessions.json

samir (IAM): KMS logs pulled; no suspicious key usage so far but ongoing. Will escalate if changes.

idp-bot: RESOLVED? Partial containment achieved. Continue monitoring.

maria (Sec Eng): Closing initial triage here; tagging @legal and @cs for potential user comms. We'll update after full root cause analysis. :thumbsup:
